According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the [[:en:Solar System|Solar System]].

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the [[:en:Solar System|Solar System]].

The relationships among the Nine Stars follow the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]]:

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

== Nine Stars Comparison Chart ==

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[:en:Folk belief|Folk belief]] originating from ancient [[:en:China|China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following [[:en:Magic square|magic square]]:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, [[:en:Yu the Great|Yu the Great]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the [[:en:Solar System|Solar System]].

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|Magic square|en|Magic square|WD=Q192089|lt=magic square}}:

== Nine Stars Comparison Chart ==

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|Magic square|en|Magic square|WD=Q192089|lt=magic square}}:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=five elements}} According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==
In Japanese {{ill|Onmyōdō|en|Onmyōdō|WD=Q1340540|lt=Onmyōdō}}, the following table associates the Nine Stars with the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=five elements}}, {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=eight trigrams}}, and colors, forming the '''Nine Stars Chart''' used to predict {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 運|1=luck|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970348}} and the {{ill|auspiciousness|ja|吉凶|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/auspiciousness|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/auspiciousness|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/auspiciousness|1=auspiciousness|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11412675}} of directions based on a person's birth year.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|Magic square|en|Magic square|WD=Q192089|lt=magic square}}:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=five elements}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|Magic square|en|Magic square|WD=Q192089|lt=magic square}}:

== Nine Stars Comparison Chart ==
{{main|{{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}|qq=}}

!style="background:white;"|{{ill|Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|lt=6🪙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}}

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=five elements}} ({{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==
In Japanese {{ill|Onmyōdō|en|Onmyōdō|WD=Q1340540|lt=Onmyōdō}}, the following table associates the Nine Stars with the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=five elements}}, {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=eight trigrams}}, and colors, forming the '''Nine Stars Chart''' used to predict {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 運|1=luck|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970348}} and the {{ill|auspiciousness|ja|吉凶|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/auspiciousness|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/auspiciousness|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/auspiciousness|1=auspiciousness|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11412675}} of directions based on a person's birth year.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|Magic square|en|Magic square|WD=Q192089|lt=magic square}}:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief|1=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China|1=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|Magic square|en|Magic square|WD=Q192089|lt=magic square|1=Magic square}}:

== Nine Stars Comparison Chart ==
{{main|{{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}|qq=}}

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=five When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great|1=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River (Henan)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief|1=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China|1=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

== Origin ==
The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|Magic square|en|Magic square|WD=Q192089|lt=magic square|1=Magic square}}:

In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Later Heaven Arrangement|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=five According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great|1=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River (Henan)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

'''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}}, Kyūsei) is a form of {{ill|Folk belief|en|Folk belief|WD=Q28401154|lt=Folk belief|1=Folk belief}} originating from ancient {{ill|China|en|China|WD=Q148|lt=China|1=China}}, consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.

The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."

When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."

According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en|Yu the Great|WD=Q627784|lt=Yu the Great|1=Yu the Great}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝|1=Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia Dynasty|13=User:Immanuelle/Xia dynasty|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 夏 (三代)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q169705}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Luo River|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 洛河|1=Luo River (Henan)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1204978}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 河図洛書}}), one of the {{ill|Hetu and Luoshu|ja|河図洛書|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hetu and Luoshu|qq=}}.

== The Nine Stars ==

Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the {{ill|Solar System|en|Solar System|WD=Q544|lt=Solar System|1=Solar System}}.
